# Western Cars Adur

> Western Cars Adur is a 24/7 local taxi and private-hire service based in Shoreham-by-Sea, serving Adur, West Sussex and airport transfers across the UK.

## Business facts

- Phone: 01273 473737
- Address: Basepoint - Shoreham, Little High Street, Shoreham-by-Sea, BN43 5EG
- Services: local taxis, fixed-fare airport transfers, corporate travel, accessible vehicles and group transport
- Airports: Gatwick, Heathrow, Stansted, Luton and London City
- Areas: Shoreham-by-Sea, Lancing, Southwick, Portslade, Hove, Brighton, Worthing, Steyning, Henfield and Burgess Hill
- Booking: online at https://westerncars.webbooker.icabbi.com/ or by phone
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/westerncarsadur/
